root_cause: Arrow key navigation uses adjustDate which adds/subtracts days without checking if the resulting date is disabled (e.g., weekends, outside min/max, or disabled by disableDayFn). Additionally, the _onKeyChange function references an undefined 'opts' variable for Escape/Enter keys.
repair_strategy: Replace the key handling logic in _onKeyChange with a helper that steps day-by-day, skipping disabled dates according to minDate, maxDate, disableWeekends, and disableDayFn, then sets the corrected date. Also define opts = self._o for the Escape/Enter cases.
expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard users can navigate to the next/previous selectable day using arrow keys, ensuring focus moves only to enabled dates, satisfying WCAG 2.1.1 (Keyboard) and 2.4.3 (Focus Order).
functional_risks: Performance impact is negligible as date ranges are limited; worst-case loops a few dozen iterations.
If minDate exceeds maxDate or all dates are disabled, the loop will terminate at the boundary due to clamping.
No change to mouse selection or other API methods; adjustDate remains unchanged for other callers.
verification_requirements: ArrowUp/Down shift by weeks while skipping weekends and respecting min/max bounds.
Navigation stops at minDate and maxDate boundaries.
Existing mouse selection and manual date entry remain functional.
